incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired: PD-INC-2026-487 — embeddings-queue-5xx-high. Severity: P2. Affected service: embeddings-ingest-eu. Link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/PD-INC-2026-487
jane: I'm oncall, taking this. acked in PD. jumping in now.
tom: thx @jane — i'll watch infra, rerouting traffic if needed.
jane: quick snapshot — error rate 5xx spiking from 0.2% -> 12% in last 5m. customers seeing 503s for embedding ops.
maria: seeing increased support tickets saying 'embedding failures' for search indexing. flagged top 3 customers: Acme, Nori Labs, Zenith.
kai: looks like KV cache under heavy eviction, maybe kvcache thrash. rolling a config to increase max_items. will test.
jane: execute plan: 1) scale embeddings pool +2 nodes, 2) enable fallback model (smaller) for retries, 3) increase kvcache memory. i'll trigger.
tom: scaling up now: `kubectl scale deploy embeddings-worker --replicas=12 -n prod-eu`
incidentbot: Deploy job started by tom — rollout id r-202631. Monitor: https://k8s.example.com/rollouts/r-202631
kai: patch to KV config pushed to canary: `PATCH /config/kvcache {"max_items": 200000}` — canary shows lowered 5xx at 1m.
jane: enabling fallback route for embedding requests: `route: embeddings->embedding-model-fast-approx (fallback)` done :white_check_mark:
maria: customer comms: posting status page update in 5m with impacted customers list. draft ready.
jane: status: 10m in — 5xx down from 12% -> 1.8%, latency improved. continuing to monitor. @maria pls coordinate cust msgs.
tom: keeping PD incident owner tag with jane until stable. if metrics back to normal for 30m we'll start handoff.
jane: if anyone needs to take over, pls ping here. otherwise i'll pass to next oncall at 3327515600.
incidentbot: Incident PD-INC-2026-487 status update: Owner=jane, EscalationPolicy=embeddings-oncall, Severity=P2
maria: posted status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/PD-INC-2026-487 — noting reduced impact and actions.
jane: thanks team, still monitoring. will post final wrap in 30m.
